project_type: Existing hackathon prototype being pivoted. Was 'EchoGuard' Wi-Fi CSI fall detection (two ESP32-S3 boards: ESP-NOW transmitter + CSI receiver streaming esp-csi CSI_DATA lines over USB serial) with a Python backend and a local Flask + vanilla JS dashboard. Pivot: a sitting/standing time tracker web app (how long you sit, how long you stand, stand reminders, daily/weekly history, health info, export to share with a health provider) plus a timed room-calibration sequence.
language: Python 3.12 (backend, Flask server), vanilla JavaScript/HTML/CSS (UI, no frameworks, no CDN), C (ESP-IDF firmware, NOT changed by this task)
build_system: Root Makefile driving .venv (created with `make setup-offline` from ~/miniconda3/bin/python3.12 with --system-site-packages). No JS build step; JS syntax is checked with node.
test_framework: pytest (pyproject.toml addopts = -q, so the summary line may be terse; rely on the exit code). Tests in tests/test_*.py, helpers tests/conftest.py and tests/csi_synth.py, fixtures in tests/fixtures/. Flask test client used in tests/test_dashboard.py (fixtures client/app/engine/data_dir). No hardware needed for any test.
build_command: .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q backend dashboard simulation && node --check dashboard/static/app.js (plus node --check on any other new .js file)
test_command: make test   (= .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/). Baseline before this task: exit 0, ~216 passed, 2 skipped.
verification_instructions: 1) make test exits 0. 2) compileall + node --check succeed. 3) Smoke-run the server on SYNTHETIC data in the background: `.venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 --simulate <scenario>` then curl http://127.0.0.1:8599/ , /api/status and the new /api/posture* endpoints, then kill the process. 4) The sandbox cannot open /dev/cu.* serial ports and cannot flash boards: never claim live-hardware verification; hardware steps become exact commands for the user.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Runtime files under data/ are gitignored (config.json, events.jsonl, recordings/*, calibration/*, exports/*, models/*). New runtime files (e.g. the posture history database) must be added to .gitignore.
setup_instructions: cd /Users/christopherryan/Projects/Hackathon; .venv already exists (if missing: make setup-offline). No network in the sandbox: nothing can be pip-installed. Available libs: numpy, scipy, pandas, pyserial, flask, pytest, stdlib sqlite3. scikit-learn is NOT installed in .venv.
environment_constraints: macOS arm64, zsh. No network (pip/CDN unavailable); runtime must be fully offline (no CDN, no web fonts, no remote calls). Sandbox cannot open /dev/cu.* serial ports and cannot flash ESP32 boards; never run firmware/flash_helper.sh or esptool write commands; the user's third ESP32 must never be touched. node at /opt/homebrew/bin/node for syntax checks only. Git repo on main with no commits: do not commit; after creating new files run `git add -N <file>` so they show in git diff. Dashboard binds 127.0.0.1 by default, has no auth (keep the existing --host warning).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING doc. Standing project rules from the earlier task: never fabricate readings in live mode; SYNTHETIC simulation data must be labelled synthetic everywhere and never used as accuracy evidence; never imply medical validation (persistent 'not a medical device' disclaimer in UI and README); no classifier accuracy claims beyond honestly-labelled within-calibration self-checks; offline operation. New user rules for this pivot: minimal UI, no gradients, no unusual/web fonts (system font stack only), dashboard showing how long you've been sitting and standing; health data must be exportable for health providers.
key_patterns: Engine (backend/engine.py): Engine.add_frame_hook(hook(frame, activity)) called in the engine thread per MotionFrame (10 Hz, backend/processing.py MotionFrame fields ts, motion_score, variance, diff_energy, baseline_deviation, quality_ok, quality_reasons...); engine.processor.last_smoothed = per-packet mean-normalised, Hampel-filtered, EMA-smoothed amplitude profile (52 LLTF subcarriers on ESP32-S3, NaN where masked); engine.processor.layout = (chip_family, n_subcarriers); engine.add_status_provider(name, fn) adds keys to engine.snapshot() (/api/status); engine.source_kind ('live'|'replay'|'simulation'), engine.synthetic, engine.calibration_info, engine.config.thresholds (MotionThresholds low/movement/rapid). Calibration (backend/calibration.py): StepSpec list STEPS (empty_baseline, walking, standing_still, sitting), CalibrationSession state machine (ready|waiting|recording|computed|failed|cancelled|saved) with begin()/tick()/add_frame()/_finish_step(), build_timeline(keys, durations, lead_in_s, grace_s, settle_s), compute_calibration(steps,...) -> dict persisted by CalibrationStore to data/calibration/<sensor_key>.json, CalibrationManager wires sessions to the engine and auto-loads matching calibrations (_apply). Config: dataclasses in backend/config.py loaded tolerantly via _build into AppConfig (data/config.json). Server: dashboard/server.py create_app(engine, root, replay_dirs, data_dir, config_path) builds managers, registers JSON routes under /api/*, raises BadRequest / domain errors mapped by errorhandlers, _json_body() and _num() validators, strict CSP header (no inline scripts, self only). UI: dashboard/static/index.html + app.js + style.css, polling with fetch, canvas charts, no external URLs (tests/test_dashboard.py::test_static_assets_have_no_external_urls). Simulation: simulation/generator.py SCENARIOS dict + scenario_segments() Segment(key, label_name, duration_s, motion), _person_amp/_displacement motion model, SimulationSource yields CSI_DATA lines marked synthetic. Code style: `from __future__ import annotations`, module docstrings, dataclasses, numpy only (no sklearn).
directory_structure: backend/ (csi_parser, sources, ports, buffer, processing, activity, detector, alerts, calibration, recording, recorder, engine, monitor, cli, export, offline, config, ml/train_rf); dashboard/ (server.py Flask app factory, __main__.py CLI, static/ UI); simulation/generator.py (synthetic CSI); tests/ (pytest + fixtures); firmware/transmitter and firmware/receiver (ESP-IDF projects, flashed and verified working by the user, unchanged here); data/ runtime files (gitignored); .agents/tasks/ planning state.
hardware_state: Two Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 boards flashed from this repo with ESP-IDF v5.5.1 (~/esp/esp-idf, `. ~/esp/esp-idf/export.sh`), USB-Serial-JTAG console. Receiver /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 (MAC D8:3B:DA:A4:4C:C8) plugged into the MacBook, 921600 baud CSI_DATA lines. Transmitter (MAC D8:3B:DA:A4:38:AC) on wall power across the room, ESP-NOW on a fixed channel, no router. User confirmed live dashboard (`make dashboard ARGS="--serial /dev/cu.usbmodem2101"`) shows real CSI and detects movement; boards repositioned diagonally. No firmware change and no reflash is planned in this task.
